decision.question: review size
decision.why: one new node script, tested by AskIndex.test.mjs, no UI; no Servex change

findings.text: The diff.patch holds only code and docs; the generated `asks.jsonl` files, `doc/refined-asks.md` pages, `asks-by-module.md`, the card and the landing line are not in it, so I could not check the counts or the card title ("Refined asks: N recorded, M crossed off, K sent…").

Server/AskIndex.mjs:20 writes `doc/refined-asks.md` where the brief said `<module>/doc/asks.md`. ext/Refine/doc/asks.md explains why (four modules already have a hand-merged `asks.md`), so I accept the change, but the owner should know the name differs.

The brief says a "landing line whose title matches" also counts as done. `done_by` (AskIndex.mjs ~l.130) only uses AskTally's judged features. The doc says AskTally's status already comes from landings, so this is a small gap; it also admits only 19 of 1061 backfilled asks are done, so most routed asks will be inboxed even if they landed.

Server/RefineQueue.mjs:171 is only reached when `p.session` is set, and `after_refine` runs outside any try/catch. An inbox or fs error would fail an otherwise-finished refine run after its card was already added. Wrapping it and logging the error would be safer.

`AskIndex.test.mjs` covers record, done, inbox-once and no duplicates on re-run, and fits the "no duplicate lines on a re-run" ask. It uses a throwaway repo, not the real `ux/Dictate` with today's asks the brief named, so that step cannot be confirmed from the diff.

noted: refined-asks.md avoids overwriting four hand-merged doc/asks.md; stated in the doc
noted: AskTally features already derive from landings; strictness is deliberate
fixed: after_refine wrapped in try/catch, error logged in run.filed_error
noted: ux/Dictate real run happens after merge in the main tree (backfill + one fresh refine)

assign.title: Refined asks: records, module lists, inboxes
assign.outcome:
**Refined asks are now records.** 1080 recorded, 19 crossed off, 612 sent to their module's inbox, 449 stay open (site-wide or no module folder).

- One record per ask, in the session's own `asks.jsonl`: [how it works](/framework/ext/Refine/doc/asks.md)
- Topic list per module, computed: [overview](/framework/ai/doc/asks-by-module.md), e.g. [ux/Dictate](/framework/ux/Dictate/doc/refined-asks.md)
- Routing runs inside the refine loop; re-runs add nothing (`node Server/AskIndex.test.mjs`).
- Differs from the brief: the page is `refined-asks.md`, because four modules already hold a hand-merged `asks.md`.
